title: Starter team checks in the next morning

source.text: Of 16 outside people who wrote a first message in the 28 days to 2026-10-27 and were old enough to return, 1 came back on the next Eastern day. 15 of 17 got an agent reply in session one.

change: The morning after a new person's first message, their starter agent posts one check-in that picks up where they left off and offers one next step. Once per person; push where registered.

metric.label: New people who come back the next day

guardrail: Starter agents removed or Rooms left by new people do not rise above the 28 days before.
